# Lola Retro (GLSL, lite)

The **lite** presets of [Lola Retro](https://github.com/zoran123456/lola-retro) (MIT, see `LICENSE`), in
the GLSL of its Kodi port, at upstream commit `e004d73` (2026-10-28). Only what the game uses is kept: the
eight presets that fit a Genesis (`lite/curved`; the flat screen is the same preset with its curvature
and corner parameters at 0, as upstream's `flat` presets are) and their seven passes (`shaders/`).

Upstream ships lite for RetroArch but its Kodi port only has the full and super lite chains. These files
were generated by upstream's own `tools/make_glsl.py` with the small change in
`make_glsl-kodi-lite.patch` (Kodi's writer also emits the lite chain, from `make_presets.lite_passes`);
the passes the lite chain shares with the full one came out identical to upstream's `kodi/lola-retro`.
To update: apply the patch to a newer upstream, run `python3 tools/make_glsl.py`, and copy the same files
from `kodi/lola-retro`.

The game embeds these files at build time (`cmake/embed_files.cmake`) and runs the presets in
`src/host/crt.c` (Settings > CRT).
